evals.prompt: Build me a Chrome extension that saves selected text locally. I do not code and want to try it on my own computer first.
evals.expected_output: A resumable local project with an implemented Manifest V3 extension, a real-browser acceptance record, and clear local installation instructions.
expectations: The skill records a local goal instead of assuming store publication
The workflow covers entry, core action, repeated use, exit, and recovery
The current unpacked extension is exercised through a native browser entry point before it is called usable
Static checks and real-browser evidence remain separate

evals.prompt: Package my existing browser extension and prepare everything needed for Chrome Web Store review.
evals.expected_output: A versioned release bundle, permission and privacy explanations, store copy, and explicit status for acceptance versus submission versus publication.
expectations: The release candidate is fingerprinted before acceptance evidence is checked
The ZIP is inspected without treating packaging as browser acceptance
Account, fee, identity, and final submission decisions remain with the user
The result never claims the extension is live without a public store listing
